dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) targeting PC environment; Portuguese-language Brazilian business application with DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, SCREEN SECTION, COPY copybooks, and FUNCTION SQRT usage consistent with GnuCOBOL on Linux/Windows PC

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian customer report generation with vendor (salesperson) assignment by geographic proximity (latitude/longitude distance calculation)
purpose.summary: RELCLI is a batch report program that prints a formatted customer list (Relatório de Clientes) filtered by code range, company name range, and salesperson. It reads customer and vendor files, calculates the nearest vendor to each customer using a Euclidean distance approximation on lat/lon coordinates, and prints paginated output to a printer file.

notable_features: FUNCTION SQRT for geographic distance calculation
ACCEPT ... FROM ESCAPE KEY for screen navigation
GO TO used for screen field back-navigation
START with NOT LESS / NOT GREATER for ISAM positioning
Multiple COPY directives for file SELECT, FD, and working-storage
WRITE ... AFTER PAGE for printer pagination
